Tarirai, Ishe Jehovha ari kuuya nesimba,
Ndianiko akayera mvura zhinji muchanza chake,
kana kuyera denga noupamhi hwechanza chake?
Ndianiko akaisa guruva rose rapasi mudengu,
Zvirokwazvo ndudzi dzavanhu dzakaita sedonhwe remvura riri muchirongo;
Rebhanoni harina huni dzinoringana kuvesa moto wearitari,
uye zvipfuwo zvaro hazvikwani kuita chipiriso chinopiswa.
Ndudzi dzose dzakaita sepasina chinhu pamberi pake;
Hamuna kunzwisisa kubva pakuvamba kwenyika here?
uye anoderedza vatongi venyika ino kuti vave pasina.
iye anofuridza pamusoro pavo vachibva vaoma, uye chamupupuri chinovakukura sehundi.
Kana kuti ndiani akaenzana neni?" ndizvo zvinotaura Iye Mutsvene.
Nokuda kwesimba rake guru uye noukuru hwesimba rake,
uye anowedzera simba kuna vasina simba.
